notes.title: Release details and a word from the team!
notes.notes:
Hey inmates!

The release is closing in, and you’ve got questions about the big day on July 18! Here are the answers you’re hunting for! Space Prison will launch during TactiCon and will be showcased from July 18 to July 22!

[i]Please note that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1865930/view/4161970072171156587]previous Steam news article[/url] incorrectly stated the [b]release time[/b] for Space Prison; the correct starting hour is [b]8:00 PM (CEST)[/b] instead of 4:00 PM (CEST).[/i] We've made a [b]release timing map[/b] further below in this post!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798268/81e8314dbef76211f4cc4b85f5da6ff44f833ca2.png[/img]

But, first off, the whole team wanted to share a word with you:

We just wanted to take this occasion to say a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] to all of you who've been testing our game and providing us with your invaluable feedback. Your input has been crucial in making Space Prison the game it is today.

Thanks to you, we've been able to fine-tune the gameplay, squash bugs, and add features that make the game even more exciting and engaging. Because of your feedback, we were able to focus on the things that really matter to you, like cool criminal characters, turn-based combat and, of course, space rats. We couldn't have done it without you!

For those of you looking to buy Space Prison, we wanted to clear up a couple of things about what the game isn't:
[list]
[*] It’s NOT a roguelike (nor a roguelite). While we do have roguelite elements like a prison map that changes every day (corridors shift, so prisoners can’t plan their escape) and player character dying, you do not need to start from scratch when you snuff it. Your consciousness is saved in the collar and transferred to a new body (“Death is not an excuse for a shorter sentence”).
[*] It’s not The Escapists. While you do plan your survival and interactions, Space Prison is more about doing quests for quirky criminals to get them to join your squad, challenging others for their spot in the gang, gathering and gearing up your party to use them in turn-based combat against other inmates, alien creatures infesting the station and prison system itself.
[*] It’s not a Space Rat Breeding Simulator. Even though, thanks to you guys, we’ve added many improvements for the rats (naming them, equipping them with tiny weapons for battle, healing them in your cell's burrow or upgrading their skills), we’re not a game about raising space rats;)
[/list]
So, if you're ready for a wild ride in the galaxy's most notorious prison, filled with tactical combat, social RPG mechanics, and a whole lot of space rats, then Space Prison is the game for you.
Thanks again for all your support and feedback. We can't wait to see you behind bars!

Cheers!

_

[h3]Release Timing[/h3]

Check out the map to lock down the release time in your zone and cellblock!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798268/eb716e2e7f66d30e73786684ae5fa04beb164eb1.jpg[/img]
[h3]Prices[/h3]

The game will be available at [b]19.99€, $19.99, £16.75[/b]. However, to celebrate your first day in prison, a [b]-10% off discount[/b] will be applied for 7 days!

[h3]Supporter Pack and Bundles[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798268/c2516732a5f40326741c70000a575956c6662223.jpg[/img]

We also have a Supporter Pack that you can buy at $7.99. It includes:
[list]
[*] Special Rat Skin
[*] Cell Decor (carpet, bigger window, string lights, flower pot, glowing skull)
[*] Digital Posters (Size A3)
[*] Wallpapers for your desktop
[*] Over 25 emojis
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798268/76c36b709a88332d22f2a287f886b9654faa40d9.jpg[/img]
Do you love survival? Fighting for your life in dark setting? Check out our complete-the-set bundle with [b]Against the Storm[/b] to have a [b]-10% discount[/b] on the game!

If you're here, you probably are a turn-based lover, we also have a surprise for you: a complete-the-set bundle with [b]USC: Counterforce[/b] coming with a[b]-10% discount off[/b] (because we never have enough tactical and turn-based games)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798268/37f881d07e19a9a22f18bccb252add0398005b02.jpg[/img]

We're so thrilled for the upcoming release. Got more questions about the game? Drop 'em in the comments or hit us up on Steam Discussions!

One more thing, the team will be live on the Steam page for the release at 8:00 PM!

Stay sharp, inmates, and keep your eyes peeled for the next step: release day!

See you behind bars!
Wooden Alien Team

notes.title: New release date!
notes.notes:
Hey inmates,

We're excited to announce the full launch of Space Prison on [b]July 18, 2024[/b]! [i]Please note that timing noted on this Steam announcement is incorrect, the release will be at 8:00 PM (CEST) and not 4:00 PM. Thank you for your understanding![/i]

After the delay of the initial launch in April and the extensive playtests we held, we're finalizing the game now. This delay allowed us to have more time to improve the game with your feedback, create more content (quests, endgame, and adding the second gang), and also showcase the game to a broader audience. The progress we've made led us to opt for a full release instead of going into Early Access. We look forward to supporting the game post-launch. Thank you for your patience and support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798268/b8b44d92e821ce1ca70e3f3ceffcaae7bf85f65e.gif[/img]

[h3]Want to see what being a prisoner will be like, try our demo![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1865930/Space_Prison/

More information on the demo here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1865930/view/4147332104858536868


We're incredibly excited about this upcoming milestone! Thank you for the feedback from the playtests and demos, we can't wait for you to play the game in full! Your ideas and input have been invaluable. As we enter this new phase, get ready—your escape plan needs to be solid, your sentence is about to begin!

Think you’re tough? This prison survival game is your ultimate test! Craft makeshift brass knuckles for turn-based brawls, form alliances with inmates using RPG-social mechanics, and uncover their backstories. You'll be thrown into the darkest, yet humor-infused hellhole, in a comic book-inspired artstyle. Your free will and identity will be suppressed. Don’t let the system break you.

[b]Wishlist[/b] the game, [b]follow[/b] us on Steam and our socials!

Until then, stay tuned because we have more news to share with you in the upcoming weeks!

notes.title: Dev Journal #3 - Player-Based Changes
notes.notes:
Hey inmates!

It's time for another update on the developments within the confines of Space Prison. We've been hard at work incorporating your [b]feedback and suggestions[/b] to improve your experience within our facility. We wanted to let you know the [b]biggest changes[/b] made since the Steam Next Fest demo, the various playtests we held, and our latest demo this year!

[h3]Before we start, your opinion is important to us, so feel free to [b]share your ideas and suggestions[/b] with our [b][url=https://spaceprison.featureupvote.com/?order=new&filter=all&tag=]upvoting tool[/url][/b]! We take all your feedback into consideration, thank you for your commitment![/h3]

[url=https://spaceprison.featureupvote.com/?order=top&filter=all&tag=][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798268/bf89d0eabe0613fb9b7ab9b95a571c4420b71e9c.png[/img][/url]
[i]As you can see, the rats are very popular![/i]


[h2]Tactical depth[/h2]

[h3]Hazards and obstacles[/h3]
Thanks to your requests, we’ve added a [b]new feature[/b] for combat encounters for more tactical depth during fights. Say hello to [b]hazards and obstacles[/b]! Combat arenas along the prison have objects that can be dangerous for you, but that you can use to your advantage if you play around them smartly. Exploit the terrain strategically to your advantage and fight your way out with more diversity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798268/0fceb018f126268ae9cbfafd89e543912408c59c.gif[/img]

[h3]Party member loadout management[/h3]
Your fellow rats and allies are now [b]fully manageable[/b] in one convenient location: the [b]party menu[/b]. Equip them with different [b]gear[/b] depending on how you want to play. From weapons and armor to specialized combat items, equip your companions with the tools they need to be your partners in crime! Oh, even the rats have their own gear with Tiny Knuckles or Rat Capes [i](yes, they wear their dead comrades as armor, that's a thing)[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798268/4ed1505bfadbf25fe29da306b7e62b81d52313c2.gif[/img]

[h2]Rat healing mechanic[/h2]
We know you formed a special bond with your rodent companions, we all do! Because you requested to be able to keep them longer and care for them, rats can now [b]heal during the night[/b]. But why stop there? We're working on a [b]dedicated area[/b] within your cell equipped with cozy [b]beds for your rat[/b] friends.

[h2]Outer ring exploration[/h2]
Want to explore beyond the familiar corners of your cell? We've added a whole new part of the prison that is [b]restricted to inmates[/b], with [b]new locations[/b] like Labs, Power Hub, or the out-of-order Prison Yard. You need to get a [b]special keycard[/b] to get there. And even if you do, you need to be extra careful, as you will be attacked at sight by merciless guards, drones, and guard dogs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798268/8e19846eac04d5aaa1396757c00d64135ca7b82f.png[/img]

[h2]Adding a second gang[/h2]
Fulfilling a long-awaited request from the community, you will have the freedom to [b]choose between two gangs[/b] and explore the [b]unique narratives[/b] and [b]quests[/b] offered by each faction and its members. So, that means you’ll have twice as many interesting NPCs with their own stories and chain quests to discover, depending on your run! (And a special gang hideout for each gang!)

[h3]Other important changes made since the Steam Next Fest Demo and playtests:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Animations:[/b] Following your feedback during the Steam Next Fest demo, we've reworked the NPC and environmental animations to make them more impactful and smoother.
[*] [b]Sound Design:[/b] You outlined the room for improvement of Space Prison music and sound design, and that is why we heard you (get it), you can listen to some of the changes in this [url=https://www.facebook.com/WoodenAlienGames/videos/750022363712832]video[/url]. We have also added new sounds for our NPCs. Music is an important topic for us as well, and we're exploring the musical atmosphere of the game. We shared one of our experiments [url=https://discord.com/channels/1092181800979288236/1092481642741907476/1197940293484417164]on our Discord[/url]!
[*] [b]Storyline & lore:[/b] You suggested that it would be nice to learn more about the Space Prison and have more lore to discover throughout the game. So, we focused on expanding it by creating unique race and crime backgrounds for NPCs, and more. Get a glimpse of the Space Prison lore in our previous [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1865930/view/7251430632280177989]Devblog[/url].[/list] https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1865930/view/7251430632280177989
[list] [*] [b]Combat balancing:[/b] Since the first public demo feedback, we have worked more on balancing out the combat and making it more interesting for you. Gear, including weapons and usable items, are not the only additions, we also implemented new abilities and created new and varied enemies.
[*] [b]Difficulty:[/b] The Space Prison is a tough place, but some of the areas seemed either a little too harsh or too easy, from what we understood after reading your comments. That is why we worked especially hard on evening them out. Based on the latest playtests and the demo, the difficulty was better handled. We'll keep on balancing the game so that it remains a challenging experience but is still approachable for the new fishes in the tank.
[*] [b]Tutorials:[/b] Some of you felt lost at times and requested more explanation of various game mechanics. We added new tutorials and improved some of the previous ones. Recently, we had some new ideas for in-game information display, we are currently working on improving the information system even further.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798268/7f6827c4a218eed59e4e86340e6dcf9a3fc7a74e.gif[/img]

We thank you all for taking part of this journey and participating in our demos and playtests. The [b]feedback[/b] you provide is invaluable to help us in the continuous improvement of the game. Your voices [b]shape the experience[/b] of Space Prison, and we're committed to delivering the best one possible!

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to develop Space Prison!

See you behind bars!

notes.title: Release delayed until later this Summer
notes.notes:
Hello inmates,

We would like to inform you that Space Prison's Early Access release has been [b]delayed to an unannounced date[/b] later this Summer, and will therefore no longer be released on its initial date of April 10, 2024.

We believe postponing the release is the best decision because we want the game to meet your highest expectations while finding the best opportunities to showcase the game to the broadest audience. We are touched to see that so many of you are excited to play the game. Our player community is more than valuable during these additional months of development. That’s why we are working on a [b]tool[/b] to let you [b]submit your ideas[/b] for features and content, and [b]vote[/b] on them. It will be released soon.

We will regularly check in with you and plan [b]closed playtests[/b]. In the meantime, the demo will still be live for a few more days. We thank you for your patience and understanding.

We are grateful for your contribution and ongoing support on this journey!

Wooden Alien & Firesquid
